portraits.name: 廖化
portraits.prompt: Edit/redesign the supplied Liao Hua hero artwork for a Three Kingdoms strategy game. The input is the old portrait; preserve only its refined historical ink-and-gouache illustration style, fine dry-brush contours, aged ivory paper texture, realistic Chinese facial anatomy and restrained earthy colors. Replace the generic ragged action pose completely. ONE clearly identifiable veteran commander, late middle age, lean long face, visible gray eyebrows, close cropped salt-and-pepper moustache and short neatly pointed gray beard, stern attentive eyes; no likeness to the supplied younger black-bearded face. Calm upright three-quarter stance facing slightly LEFT, seen from head to upper thighs. Compact Han-era iron lamellar armor, an intact muted dark moss-green cloak neatly fastened at the shoulder, practical dark iron helmet with a small open face guard, no exaggerated fur and no torn beggar clothing. His right hand rests naturally on the sheathed sword at his waist; his left hand holds ONE straight spear vertically at his side. Both hands anatomically correct, believable grip. Head, helmet and neck fully visible, silhouette tall and composed, no running or lunging. Quiet misty green-gray mountain pass and a distant fortified gate, no horse, no snowstorm, no water, background subordinate. Face is clear in the upper third, eyes near 28 percent down the image, head well below the top edge, the figure occupies about 75 percent of image width; keep all key features inside the central 80 percent. Intended display is a small portrait card with top corner UI and a bottom 23 percent text overlay, so put face, hands and defining armor above the bottom overlay. Full-bleed portrait aspect ratio 350:480, high resolution, opaque artwork, absolutely no borders, card frame, UI, writing, labels, numbers, text, watermark, extra persons, disembodied arms, duplicated hands, fused weapons, fantasy glow, 3D render, photographic skin or anime. The result should read as a disciplined gray-bearded mountain veteran distinct from a blue naval officer and a youthful red-armored raider.

portraits.prompt: Edit/redesign the supplied Ding Feng hero portrait for a Three Kingdoms strategy game. The input is the old portrait; preserve refined ink-and-gouache historical Chinese illustration, crisp dry-brush marks, subtle aged paper, muted iron/crimson colors and painterly realism. ONE lean athletic short-blade specialist in his early middle age, narrow angular Chinese face, CLEAN SHAVEN with no moustache or beard, sharp focused eyes; close-fitting open-face iron helmet with a SHORT red plume and a clearly visible face and neck.
